lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The audit shell closes itself. What replaces it is one line of text, in the system's plainest face.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: ACCESS REVOKED — ALLOCATION AUDITOR, ENCLAVE 7 — REVIEW FLAG APPLIED — ORIGINATING DEPARTMENT: —

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: There is no originating department. That field is not optional. A flag is raised by somebody and the system records who, every time, without exception.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Eleven years of flags and every single one of them came from somewhere. This one came from the same place the budget line goes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The corridor lights come on in sequence, from the far end, toward you. Nobody has walked down that corridor since six.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Kell. The monastery up the valley. Four hours on foot and the last place in this Enclave system that does not report to anyone.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Go. The door is the only way out, and in about ninety seconds it is going to be the only way in.
